caveats: confirmed_executed and static_candidates are different evidence classes and must never be added together.
A confirmed address is a source fetch of its execute packet, not a predicate-body execution.

The confirmed set is biased against unimplemented instructions: a packet that faults is never confirmed, so recorded_unsupported_faults is the only confirmed-executed evidence an unimplemented instruction can have.
static_candidates is byte-pattern presence in captured memory. Probable code and unclassified memory are not promoted to confirmed code.

Captured images cover L2, shared RAM and the SDRAM pages a checkpoint happened to hold; code in uncaptured SDRAM is invisible to the scan, so not-found means not found here, not absent from the firmware.
Disassembly decides what a word names; the core decides what it executes. The two disagree where a format is decoded but unimplemented.

compact_encoding_space.confirmed_executed_caveat: These 16-bit words sit at confirmed-executed compact addresses yet the sweep rejects them under all 13 of its header configurations. Either the real fetch-packet header is outside the swept set or the word means something else under it, so 6,944 is an upper bound on unimplemented compact words, not a verified count.
compact_encoding_space.noise_floor_definition: distinct unimplemented compact words a control blob of the same size yields through the identical pipeline
compact_encoding_space.note: A 16-bit word present at a compact position is presence, not execution; the core rejects all of these words today.

long40_compare_and_shift.derivation: register-pair src operand on cmpeq/cmpgt/cmpgtu/cmplt/cmpltu/shl/shr/shru - an operand shape, not a Table A-1 row

nonconditional_extensions.derivation: unimplemented rows whose every rejected probe encoding carries TI's unconditional bits 31-28 = 0001 (audit section 5.1)

ISA-ADDR.requirement: Address arithmetic in byte/halfword/word/doubleword addressing modes

ISA-CTRL-MISC.requirement: Control-register move, interrupt gating, NOP/IDLE, software exceptions and the delayed .M move

ISA-INT-SAT.requirement: Scalar saturating integer arithmetic and saturate

ISA-INT-SHIFT.requirement: Non-saturating and variable-saturating shifts and rotate

ISA-MEM-SCALAR.requirement: Scalar loads and stores including aligned/nonaligned and doubleword

ISA-MPY-PACKED.requirement: Packed and complex multiplies and dot products

ISA-MPY16.requirement: Non-saturating 16x16 multiplies, all signedness and halfword-selection permutations

ISA-PACK16.requirement: Packed 2x16 arithmetic, compare, min/max and shift

scope: Reachability only: which unimplemented instructions the captured firmware executed, and which merely appear in captured bytes.

calibration.rationale: Instruction-level calibration: these are almost certainly absent from a bare-metal audio decoder (Galois multiply is channel ECC done in dedicated silicon; SWE/SWENR are OS supervisor entry). Whatever they score in the firmware is this method spurious-hit rate for a narrow opcode, alongside their control-blob counts.

executed_cross_check.note: The cross-check can only speak for executed fetch packets the captured images actually contain; the rest of the replayed code lives in SDRAM pages no checkpoint holds.

noise_floor.definition: per-mnemonic control hits SCALED to the firmware decoded-position exposure, max over the control blobs, then compared with a three-sigma margin.  Raw counts are not comparable: the control blobs decode far fewer positions than the firmware, which biases a raw comparison toward crediting the firmware.
